PainterlyNPR__AssetCatalogue__Config__Me.ConfigNote: The pull-out catalogue left of the sheet: what it remembers per viewer, how a card is dragged onto the sheet, the drop marker, and its words.

PainterlyNPR__AssetCatalogue__Config__Dr.Note: Remembered per viewer, as the folds are: whether the drawer is out, and which pictures its cards show.
PainterlyNPR__AssetCatalogue__Config__Dr.ThumbsNote: RND shows each asset as it is drawn (pen and wash); PXY its proxy, as the SketchUp and three.js apps preview it

PainterlyNPR__AssetCatalogue__Config__Dr.Note: A card moved this far with the button down is a drag; less is a click, which arms a placement - the next click on the sheet places it (Esc cancels), as an art direction point is placed.
PainterlyNPR__AssetCatalogue__Config__Dr.FootprintMinMNote: The marker's smallest radius on the ground, so a lavender's still shows where it lands
